post.summary: Full one-shot Shopify onboarding: webhooks + pixel ScriptTag
post.description:
Single endpoint that handles the entire Shopify technical setup:
  1. Registers all required webhooks (orders, carts, customers, refunds)
  2. Installs tracker.js via ScriptTag API (no theme editing needed)

Requires Admin API token scopes:
  read_orders, write_webhooks, read_script_tags, write_script_tags

ScriptTag falls back gracefully — if write_script_tags scope is missing
the response indicates the manual install snippet should be shown to the user.

get.summary: Aggregate orders by buyer-declared source, with UTM cross-check

For each declared source bucket, returns:

actor.title: Actor
actor.description: Stable identifier of the human who authorised this decision (e.g. a user slug or UUID — not a service identity). When transmitted by `hermes_service`, this MUST be the human actor_id, never the service name. Enforcement of non-service identity is a Core invariant (Etapa 4). A future field `approval_event_id` will reference the canonical Telegram approval event once that audit chain is available.

ChangeConfidence.title: ChangeConfidence
ChangeConfidence.description: Confidence for change log entries (distinct from Level used in intel objects).

Level.title: Level
Level.description: Generic LOW / MEDIUM / HIGH — used for confidence, priority and risk.

MetricDomain.title: MetricDomain
MetricDomain.description:
Semantic domain of a MetricValue — what truth the metric belongs to.
Distinct from the source system that provided the raw data.

Source systems (google_ads, meta_ads, ga4, shopify) are NOT MetricDomain.
The Core is the sole authority for assigning domain.
Hermes treats a missing or unknown domain as None; it never infers or assigns domain.

Separation from DataHealthEntry.domain (which mixes semantic + source) is intentional:
MetricDomain is the semantic layer only.

MetricRef.title: MetricRef
MetricRef.description:
Points to one or more snapshots (for diagnoses/recommendations) or
to a contract path (for narratives).

At least one of snapshot_ids or contract_path must be provided.

SourceState.title: SourceState
SourceState.description: State of a data source (core_data_sources, core_data_health).

TextWithRefs.title: TextWithRefs
TextWithRefs.description: A human-readable statement that may contain {{mN}} placeholders.

ValueStatus.title: ValueStatus
ValueStatus.description: State of a specific metric value (core_metric_snapshots, metric contracts).

ErrorOut.title: ErrorOut
ErrorOut.description: Standard error envelope for 401, 403, 409, 429 and 503 responses.

detail.title: Detail
detail.description: Human-readable explanation. Absent on 4xx responses that must not leak information.

request_id.title: Request Id
request_id.description: Echoed from X-Request-ID request header, when provided.

BearerAuth.description:
Per-scope Bearer token (env-var, server-side only).

| Scope | Env var | Allowed operations |
|---|---|---|
| `agency_admin` | `AGENCY_API_ADMIN_KEY` | All endpoints |
| `hermes_service` | `AGENCY_API_HERMES_KEY` | All operational reads; intel writes (diagnoses, recommendations, changes, narratives, learning candidates, alert feedback); transmits human decisions to `/decision` endpoints |
| `platform_web` | `AGENCY_API_PLATFORM_KEY` | All operational reads; action-event and replay writes; narrative transitions |
| `client_viewer` | Supabase Auth JWT | Own-client read-only (reports only — `GET /clients/{id}/reports`) |

**Scope clarification (CCR-009):**

- _All operational reads_ means every `GET` route **except** `GET /jobs` and `GET /jobs/{id}`, which are `agency_admin` only.
- `client_viewer` has no access to any route except `GET /clients/{id}/reports`.
- The grant matrix per operation is the authoritative source — see `x-grant-scopes` on each operation.

**Note — `hermes_service` and `/decision`:** Hermes acts as a transport layer for a human decision made in Telegram. The `actor` field in the request body MUST contain the human actor_id, not the service identity. Enforcement of non-service identity is a Core invariant (Etapa 4). A future `approval_event_id` field will reference the canonical audit event.
